purpose: Which Agent Skills-compatible clients Shipmates could be a target for, and what each one costs. This is the roster audit epic #164 exists to produce: it answers 'should we add more targets' with per-client first-party evidence instead of a count.

policy.shared-tree: A client that reads the open `.agents/skills/` tree needs NO adapter: the commands and the toolbox already land there for codex, antigravity, github-copilot and pi. The shared tree is the cheap path, and it is why a client can be 'shared-free' without being a target.
policy.named-target: A named target is earned, not assumed: it needs a per-harness payload (dialect, crew location, steering), a digest fixture, the install/doctor lifecycle, a harness-matrix entry, and a receiver who can run it. Two of the nine - grok-build and devin - ship the NATIVE tree rather than the shared one, because the eighteen commands must stay user-invoked only and that guard is a vendor frontmatter key the neutral two-key rendering drops. Native adapters are therefore the norm when a harness's own guard semantics matter, not a failure of the shared-tree idea.
policy.evidence: Every row carries a first-party doc URL, the date it was checked, and the literal path string it yielded. A row with no path string is `watch`, never a guess: absence of evidence is recorded as absence, not as a feature.
policy.promotion: Promote a candidate only when the crew has somewhere to land (`subagents` is not `unknown`/absent) and someone can run the harness end to end; until then a captain on that client can still point their harness at the shared tree.

source.name: Agent Skills - Client Showcase
source.note: The showcase is the census anchor: 46 clients, each with a first-party instructions link. Two shipped targets are not on it (antigravity, grok-build) and devin replaced a product that was, so the roster is the union.

verdict_values.shipped: A named target with an adapter, digest and install lifecycle.
verdict_values.shared-free: Reads the shared `.agents/skills/` tree; commands and tools land with no adapter work.
verdict_values.native-adapter: Documents its own skills tree; a target needs an adapter before it can ship.
verdict_values.watch: On the showcase, but no tree path was obtained this pass.
verdict_values.skip: Not a coding harness Shipmates can drive.
